dossier.about: My current priority is investing in and building with AI to benefit humanity. Recently, I've co-founded Inflection.AI and ManasAI.co. I am active in all facets of the consumer internet and software industries. My focus spans product development, innovation, business strategy, and finance. My expertise also extends to general management, operations, business development, talent management, and marketing. I have founding and investing experience with seed-stage to massive scale companies such as LinkedIn, OpenAI, PayPal, Airbnb, Facebook/Meta, Mozilla, and Zynga, as well as world-scale companies like Microsoft. My specialties include general management, product development, strategy, negotiation, financing, deal structuring, international business, marketing, brand development and management, business development, public relations, press strategy, payments infrastructure, financial services, mergers and acquisitions, startups, software development, operations centers, board management, and investing.

lines.text: Co-Founder, LinkedIn, Manas AI & Inflection AI. Founding Team, PayPal. Author of Superagency. Podcaster of Possible and Masters of Scale.

My current priority is investing in and building with AI to benefit humanity. Recently, I've co-founded Inflection.AI and ManasAI.co. I am active in all facets of the consumer internet and software industries. My focus spans product development, innovation, business strategy, and finance. My expertise also extends to general management, operations, business development, talent management, and marketing. I have founding and investing experience with seed-stage to massive scale companies such as LinkedIn, OpenAI, PayPal, Airbnb, Facebook/Meta, Mozilla, and Zynga, as well as world-scale companies like Microsoft. My specialties include general management, product development, strategy, negotiation, financing, deal structuring, international business, marketing, brand development and management, business development, public relations, press strategy, payments infrastructure, financial services, mergers and acquisitions, startups, software development, operations centers, board management, and investing.
United States
Co-Founder, Executive Board Chair at Manas AI
Co-Founder, Board Member at Inflection AI
Partner at Greylock
Chair at Village Global
Board Member at Microsoft
Board Member at Aurora
Member, World Economy Advisory Board at SEMAFOR
Board Member at NAUTO
Board Member at Entrepreneur First
Honorary Fellow at Wolfson College, Oxford
Dean's Senior Fellow at Cambridge Judge Business School
Visiting Senior Fellow at The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)
Advisory Member at Reinvent Capital
Founder of LinkedIn & Board Member of Microsoft Focused on exploring the world of AI

Excited to announce the launch of Manas AI –– a full stack AI company setting out to shift drug discovery from a decade-long process to one that takes a few years; bringing life-saving treatments to patients faster than ever.
There may be 20 million AI agents running at Microsoft right now — but managing them all has yet to be solved.
I asked Reid Hoffman, the founder of LinkedIn, a few questions. His book “Super Agency” is out now!
Be strategic about your optimism.
The smartest AI companies need people willing to tell them they’re wrong.

AI is quickly reshaping our world. So how do we maximize the good — and minimize the harm? At #CGI2026, @reidhoffman lays out where he’d start: oversight, community buy-in, clear standards, and global cooperation. 📷: @lssmedia

At #MoSSummit 2025, @brenebrown and @reidhoffman took the stage for a powerful conversation on empathy, courage, and what it takes to lead in a rapidly changing world. Want a seat in the room for conversations like this? 🚀 Join us at Masters of Scale Summit 2026 in San Francisco. Apply at the link in our bio.

Americans are right to demand that the Al transformation serve their needs, not just the interests of the already rich and powerful. We must deliver economic prosperity for the American people, along with Al for America.

Giving robots knives sounds dangerous, but physical weakness can be a built-in safety feature. Physical Intelligence co-founder @chelseabfinn shares when a robot is safe enough to leave the lab on this week’s Possible.
Mutual adaptation, not automation — how artist @sougwen thinks about AI collaboration.
“Sometimes people think I’m in love with the robot.” Artist @sougwen on what actually happens when human and machine create together.
Artist @sougwen spent 10 years teaching robots to draw. Here’s the one thing she’ll never teach them. Watch this week’s episode of Possible on YouTube or wherever you get your podcasts.
